facts.business: Shipwaves Online Limited is a digital freight forwarding and logistics company providing a cloud-based SaaS platform for end-to-end freight management, along with 3PL services including transportation, warehousing, and cross-border freight solutions.
key_risks: Concentration of business in subsidiary Shipwaves Online LLC
Dependence on related party transactions with subsidiary (up to Rs. 100 Crores approved)
Expansion into new geographies (MENA, Saudi Arabia, Africa) carries execution risk
Technology development and adoption risk for AI/ML-based logistics platform
Regulatory and compliance risks across multiple jurisdictions
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions with subsidiary Shipwaves Online LLC (87% holding) approved for aggregate value up to Rs. 100 Crores from AGM 2026 to AGM 2027. Transactions in FY2025-26 totaled Rs. 1,480.36 lakhs including freight income, freight charges, interest income, software development expenses, and loan given.
